name: migration-wave-check
description: Read an application migration wave plan (CSV, JSON or YAML) and report what makes a wave unsafe to run: an application that moves before what it depends on, dependency loops and unknown ids, a dependency on an application planned for retire, a move with no rollback or test plan, stateful data with no sync method, a DNS TTL longer than the cutover window, a missing strategy or owner, and a wave over its limit. Each finding has its row or JSON pointer and line and quotes the guidance page or the RFC it rests on. Fetches nothing, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
